I: › [ I ] to breathe fast and with difficulty, usually because you have been exercising

NONE: › to be breathing with difficulty because you have been doing physical exercise
氣喘吁吁，呼吸急促
› to breathe fast and with difficulty, usually because you have been exercising
氣喘吁吁

I or T: › [ I or T ] to smoke tobacco
› [ I or T ] to blow out in clouds, or make steam or smoke do this

C: › [ C ] a small amount of smoke, air, or something that can rise into the air in a small cloud
一小口（煙霧），一小股（空氣）
› [ C ] a piece of food made of puff pastry filled with something sweet or with food such as cheese
› [ C ] informal mainly disapproving US also puff piece a piece of writing or speech that praises something too much

example: He came puffing up the stairs.
他氣喘吁吁地上了樓。
[ + speech ] "I ran all the way home," she puffed (= said while puffing).
「我是一路跑回家的，」她氣喘吁吁地說。
She was puffing on a cigarette at the time.
她當時正在吸煙。
He sat there, puffing away at a cigarette.
他坐在那裡，抽著煙。
The engine puffed a huge cloud of steam, then rolled down the tracks.
火車頭噴出一大股水蒸氣，沿著軌道開始移動。
The chimney was puffing out clouds of smoke.
煙囪向外冒出一縷縷的煙。
Sean blew a puff of smoke at his reflection in the mirror.
尚恩朝鏡中的自己噴了一口煙。
He hit the ground with his stick and a puff of dust rose up into the air.
他用拐杖敲打地面，揚起一股浮塵。
a cream/jam puff
鮮奶油／果醬鬆餅
cheese puffs
起司鬆餅
She took a puff on her cigarette and thought for a moment.
她抽了一口煙，沉思了一會兒。

NONE: › a poisonous African snake that swells to a larger size when it is attacked
（非洲）鼓腹巨蝰
› pastry with a lot of thin layers that swells to a larger size when baked
泡芙，鬆餅，千層酥麵團
› to make your chest or your face become bigger by filling it with air
鼓起（胸膛或臉頰）

example: He puffed out his cheeks and sat back in his chair.
他鼓著腮幫子，坐回椅子上。

NONE: › to become larger or full of air, or to make something become larger in this way
（使）膨脹，（使）鼓起

example: When the crust is golden and puffed up, take the pie out of the oven.
當外面的酥皮變成金黃色並鼓起來時，把餡餅從烤箱拿出來。

NONE: › If part of your body puffs up, it becomes bigger because it is infected or injured.
（因感染或受傷）腫脹

example: My leg puffed up all around the insect bite.
我腿上被昆蟲叮咬的部位腫了起來。

NONE: › a short sleeve that swells out into a ball shape
泡泡袖

C: › a large, white, round fungus that can be eaten
› also puffball skirt a skirt that has a rounded shape because it is gathered (= pulled together in folds) in at the bottom

NONE: › breathing with difficulty because you have been doing physical exercise
氣喘吁吁的，呼吸急促的

example: I can't walk any further - I'm puffed!
我再也走不動了，我快喘不過氣來了！

NONE: › a steam train (= train driven by steam)
蒸汽火車
› a bird with a large, brightly coloured beak that lives near the sea in northern parts of the world
海鸚，角嘴海雀
› If the skin around your eyes is puffy, it is slightly swollen.
（眼睛）腫脹的，腫大的

example: His eyes were still puffy with sleep.
他的眼睛因為睡覺所以還是腫腫的。
